blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Letran kept San Sebastian winless in Group B with a 99-62 win in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Friday. The Knights’ 37-point rout of the Golden Stags also fueled the Season 101 finalists to a 2-0 start to the young season following their opening win over Perpetual. “Our main focus was our defense because we needed to work on that during the preseason,” Chad Gammad said. “We just tried to work hard in this game and it came with the preparation that we did.
